sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Choose the correct article to fill in the blank: I saw ___ eagle flying high up in the clear blue sky.
What is the feminine gender noun for a 'horse'?
According to the poem 'The Rainbow', what builds a beautiful road from the earth to the sky?
Fill in the blank with the correct adjective of comparison: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the entire world.
In the poem 'The Frog', where does the frog usually like to sit and rest?
options: D) High up in a tree

questions.question_text: Choose the correct tense of the verb: They ___ football in the park every single evening.
Identify the correct pronoun: The little brown dog wagged ___ tail happily when it saw the bone.
In the story 'Papa's Spectacles', where did Papa finally find his missing glasses?
Identify the auxiliary (helping) verb in this sentence: The students are reading their storybooks silently.
Why did the king deeply admire the bird in the story 'The Wise Parrot'?
options: A) Because it had colorful feathers
B) Because it could sing beautifully
C) Because it was very wise and gave good advice
D) Because it could fly very fast
questions.answer: C) Because it was very wise and gave good advice

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: According to the poem 'The Rainbow', where do boats and ships sail, and what is prettier than both of them? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: According to the poem, boats sail on rivers and ships sail on seas, but the clouds that sail across the open sky are far prettier than these.

questions.question_text: Identify and separate the subject and the predicate in this sentence: 'The big yellow school bus stopped safely at the station.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The subject is 'The big yellow school bus', which tells us what the sentence is about. The predicate is 'stopped safely at the station'.

questions.question_text: How did the child feel in the story 'Gone with the Scooter', and what was the reason for this feeling? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The child felt very sad and disappointed when the scooter was gone because he really loved riding it around the neighborhood and feeling the cool breeze.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following sentence by changing the singular nouns to plural nouns: 'The child saw a colorful leaf falling from the tall tree.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The rewritten sentence is: 'The children saw colorful leaves falling from the tall trees.' We correctly changed child to children, leaf to leaves, and tree to trees.

questions.question_text: How did the parrot prove its wisdom to the king in the story 'The Wise Parrot'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The parrot proved its wisdom by giving the king clever and thoughtful advice during difficult times, helping him solve complex problems that no one else could.

questions.question_text: Describe the funny chaos that happened in the house when Papa lost his glasses in 'Papa's Spectacles'. How did the search end? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: When Papa lost his spectacles, the entire house was turned upside down. Everyone frantically searched under the beds, behind the sofas, and inside the wooden cupboards. Finally, someone laughed and pointed out that the spectacles were simply resting on top of his own head.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following paragraph entirely in the Simple Past Tense: 'She goes to the local market early. She buys fresh fruits from the vendor. Then, she walks back home happily with her bags.' [40-50 words]
questions.answer: She went to the local market early. She bought fresh fruits from the friendly street vendor. Then, she walked back home happily with her heavy bags. This shows that all these actions were completely finished in the past.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Imagine you are the frog from the poem 'The Frog'. Write a short paragraph describing a typical day sitting by the pond and catching your food. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I am a small green frog living near a quiet, muddy pond. I spend my entire day sitting patiently on a wet lily pad. Whenever a juicy fly buzzes by, I quickly stick out my long, sticky tongue to catch my delicious lunch. After eating, I enjoy listening to the splashing water and croaking loudly.

questions.question_text: Write a short descriptive paragraph about your favorite season, using at least three adjectives of comparison (like colder, brightest) and two pronouns. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: My favorite season is winter because it is much colder than the harsh summer. The days are shorter, but the sparkling snow makes everything look the most beautiful. We wear our thickest woolen sweaters and enjoy hot chocolate near the fire. I love it when we build big snowmen in our front yard.
